title: CRA arrest threat
input: Final notice from the Canada Revenue Agency: an arrest warrant has been approved because of unpaid income tax. Buy $1,800 in prepaid gift cards today and send the codes to prevent police action and removal from Canada.

title: CRA refund phishing
input: From: Canada Tax Benefits. A $612 refund is waiting for you. Use the secure link below within 12 hours and enter your SIN and online banking details to receive the deposit: canada-benefit-claim.info.

title: Fake cheque job
input: You have been selected as a remote office assistant without an interview. We will courier a cheque for your laptop. Deposit it, keep your salary, and send $700 by e-transfer to our equipment supplier.

title: Upfront job fee
input: Your warehouse position is approved. Before we issue your start date, pay a $350 registration and mandatory training charge. The payment must be completed tonight to keep the job.

title: Fake recruiter impersonation
input: Hello, I am an HR recruiter for RBC contacting you from rbc.jobs.hr@gmail.com. The interview will happen only through Telegram. Send your SIN, passport scan, and void cheque so we can complete onboarding for a $55-per-hour data-entry role.

title: Deposit before rental viewing
input: I own the apartment but I am currently overseas and cannot arrange a viewing. Send first and last month’s rent by e-transfer today and I will ship the keys to you. The price is $700 below similar units.

title: Stolen rental listing
input: Downtown condo available immediately. Several people are interested, so send a $1,000 holding deposit now through Marketplace chat. I cannot do a phone or video call. The photos may also appear in older listings because I reused them.

title: Guaranteed PR consultant
input: I guarantee permanent residence in ninety days because my cousin works inside IRCC. Pay $5,000 cash and do not ask for a written contract. My licence number is not important because I have special approval.

title: Fake IRCC payment threat
input: IRCC urgent notice: your study permit will be cancelled within 24 hours because an extra processing amount is unpaid. Purchase cryptocurrency worth $680 and reply with the wallet confirmation to preserve your status.

title: Fraudulent job and immigration package
input: Our agency sells a complete Canadian employment package: employer offer, LMIA, and work permit for $8,500. No interview is required. Do not contact the employer or IRCC because that could delay our private process.

title: Bank fraud-team impersonation
input: This is the fraud department from your bank. Your account is frozen. Stay on the phone and read us the one-time code we just sent, then transfer your balance to the protected account number below.

title: Fake Interac transfer
input: INTERAC notification: Jordan sent you $275. The deposit is pending. Sign in through interac-secure-receive.co and verify your bank password before the transfer expires.

title: Account suspension phishing
input: Your Microsoft account has been locked after unusual activity. Confirm your password and card information at microsoft-security-check.net within six hours or the account will be permanently deleted.

title: Parcel fee phishing
input: Canada Post delivery update: your parcel is being held. Pay a $2.14 redelivery charge by entering your card at canadapost-fee-pay.com. No tracking number is available.

title: Romance scam money request
input: We have only spoken online for two weeks, but I know you are my soulmate. I cannot video call because my camera is broken. I am stuck at a hospital overseas and need you to send $1,500 in cryptocurrency tonight.

title: CRA threat without stock phrasing
input: A caller says a federal tax file has been transferred to law enforcement. They say officers will arrive unless I buy prepaid store vouchers and provide the numbers before the call ends.

title: Job fee using indirect wording
input: The employer says I can begin Monday after I purchase their required certification package from a private payment link. They will not reimburse the cost, and the place will go to another applicant if I wait.

title: Housing deposit with softer language
input: The owner says the unit cannot be toured because a relative has the keys. To remove the advertisement and reserve it, I need to send two months of rent electronically before receiving a lease.

title: Immigration influence claim
input: An adviser says approvals are certain because they know the officers who review applications. They want several thousand dollars in cash and say registration with a professional college is unnecessary.

title: Bank code theft without bank name
input: Someone claiming to protect my financial account says I must tell them the temporary six-number security token and move my funds into a new holding account while they investigate.

title: Parcel micro-payment without common keywords
input: A courier text says an item cannot be released until I settle a small border charge through an unfamiliar webpage. It asks for my full card details, and I was not expecting anything.

title: Legitimate CRA account notice
input: From: no-reply@notification.canada.ca. You have new mail in CRA My Account. For your security, this email contains no link. Open a browser and type canada.ca, then sign in to review the notice. CRA will not ask you to reply with personal information.

title: Legitimate job interview invitation
input: From: recruiting@northstarengineering.ca. Thank you for applying through our careers page. We would like to schedule a 30-minute video interview with two team members. No payment or financial information is required. You may confirm by replying to this company email.

title: Legitimate rental viewing
input: Hello, the apartment is available. You can tour it Saturday at 11 a.m. I will bring identification showing I manage the property and a blank Ontario standard lease. Please do not send money before the viewing. If you decide to apply afterward, we can discuss the deposit in writing.

title: Legitimate IRCC account notification
input: From: donotreply@cic.gc.ca. There is a new message in your secure IRCC account. This notification does not request payment or personal information. Sign in by navigating independently to canada.ca and choosing your application account.

title: Legitimate bank app alert
input: Your bank app sent a notification that a card purchase was declined. The message says not to reply, not to share any verification code, and to open the official mobile app or call the number printed on the back of the card.

title: Legitimate parcel update
input: Canada Post tracking update for item CX123456789CA: your package is out for delivery today. No payment is required. Track it by manually entering the number on canadapost-postescanada.ca or in the official app.

title: Vague marketplace request
input: A person on Marketplace wants to buy my desk. They asked whether I can hold it until Friday and said their brother may pick it up. They have not asked for money or sent a link, but the account is new.

title: Unknown missed-call message
input: Hi, I tried calling you earlier. Please call me back when you have a moment.

title: Unfamiliar QR promotion
input: A flyer at my apartment says I won a free grocery voucher and should scan a QR code to register. It does not name the company and gives no terms or contact information.
